entries.message: Improve sync recovery and backup controls, harden artwork caching, and add configurable Windows ports.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Choose a dashboard port during Windows installation or upgrade, with the setting applied to the service, tray, shortcuts, and optional firewall rule.
Fix: Use SHA-256 poster-cache IDs and re-key existing cache rows without losing stored artwork.
Fix: Check SQLite integrity before a full restore and explain recovery options when the database is corrupt.
Fix: Refresh Resume and Up Next after focus or connectivity returns, and sort resume cards by the latest parsed progress update.
Fix: Retry an episode mutation once after refreshing stale series indexes for Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin.
Fix: Show the final provider reason when a destination is skipped in Sync Activity.
Fix: Start media details at the top of their scroll area.
Tweak: Set separate retention periods for local and remote full backups.
Tweak: Default backup retention to seven days.
